summary: IDS feed s101_single is degraded due to high encrypted traffic share (70.7% vs 60% tolerance). All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLANs, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 71% of bytes are TLS-encrypted and delivered directly to the IDS without broker-based decryption or SSL visibility. No decryption zone/proxy is stripping or offloading encryption before the tool, so payload remains opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature matching and anomaly detection. With >60% encrypted, most sessions cannot be inspected, significantly reducing detection coverage for exploits, malware and C2 hidden inside TLS.

recommended_fix.why: Selective decryption or key-sharing before the IDS will bring encrypted share below the 60% tolerance and restore payload visibility for detection, without changing TAP/SPAN or adding load.
